title: Recall Crystal
text: Right-click to choose a personally recorded waymark and channel in place for three seconds. Moving, taking damage or switching away from the crystal interrupts travel; looking around does not. Use the button beside a destination to forget it without destroying the waymark or affecting other players. Right-click the waymark again to record it once more.
Base cost is 100 mana within a dimension or 300 across dimensions, subject to cost reductions. Only successful travel spends mana, and the crystal is reusable.

Recall while riding to bring your mount with you, retaining cargo, fluids, core and upgrades. Stop before channeling; moving the mount or dismounting interrupts recall. The waymark needs enough safe space for the whole group. Large Create contraptions and physically assembled Aeronautics structures cannot travel directly.
